answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller to lock $100 in collateral for 90 days before receiving a fixed daily order quota. Agents selling an opal or a relic face the same rule, even if they wander between product categories. Creating 1,000 fake sellers therefore ties up $100,000; splitting one deposit among aliases earns no extra quota because each quota requires a full bond. Sybils remain possible, but their capacity scales with committed capital.
